$note: Ground-truth vectors captured from the REAL Midnight wallet SDK, out of tree, on 2026-09-11. They exist so `shielded-monitor/hd.ts` and `shielded-monitor/derive-key-cli.ts` can be proven to reproduce what a wallet does, rather than merely to implement BIP-0032 correctly (which `test/shielded-monitor/hd.test.ts` checks separately against BIP-0032's own official test vector 1).
$why-no-seeds-here: This file records ONLY PUBLIC keys. The seeds are named by a recipe and constructed in the test; the derived Zswap role seed and the serialized encryption secret key are NOT recorded in any form. That is not cosmetic: this repository's own gitleaks rule `umbradb-wallet-seed-hex` exists to catch a 64-hex value in a seed- or secret-named field, and .gitleaks.toml records as an audit finding that a path allowlist is a permanent global exemption and was removed. Committing synthetic secret material and then suppressing the scanner would disarm that gate for everyone; committing no secret material keeps it armed. The public keys below are what the derivation is actually FOR — they are the shielded address a funder pays — and a wrong role seed cannot produce a right public key, so the vectors lose no strength.
